name: Giant donkeyberry
desc: A woody shrub of dry bushveld whose leaves and berries are eaten by elephant and by duikers and bushbuck.
about: Grewia hexamita, the giant raisin, is a species of flowering plant in the family Malvaceae, native to Mozambique and adjoining countries. It is a large tree for a Grewia, reaching 5 m (16 ft).
